docs_description: Guides and reference material for the KrakStack template.
docs_permissions_description: This reference is generated from the same access catalog used by the application at runtime.
docs_permissions_matrix_title: Role access and API key ceilings
docs_permissions_matrix_description: Each row comes from the configured action catalog. Checks show actions assigned to a role or allowed by an API key ceiling.
docs_permissions_ceilings_description: An API key ceiling is the maximum set of actions that type of key may receive. It does not grant those actions by itself, and an empty ceiling means that type of key cannot receive any project action.
docs_permissions_user_intersection: A user API key receives only actions present in all three sets: its requested grant, the user API key ceiling, and its owner's active role permissions.
docs_permissions_other_intersection: Organization and service API keys receive only actions present in both their requested grant and their corresponding ceiling. Runtime policy checks then evaluate that effective set.
